About page p1: Tural Mammadov - Head of the World Alliance Chamber of Commerce in China, has been in business for 2 years in Turkey, 3 years in Dubai, and more than 18 years in several cities in China. These activities include State Tenders and Import and Export for local entrepreneurs in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Russia and Azerbaijan. These activities are carried out reliably through his own Import and Export company, and the clients are completely satisfied. One of the biggest advantages of his membership in the World Alliance is that he and his company are recognized at the state level and are given special respect by the Chamber of Commerce of the People's Republic of China.
About page p2: Mr. Mammadov, who is originally from Azerbaijan, also has activities related to his own country. The largest of these activities is the “Sea Breeze” project, in which investors from various countries (Russia, UAE) have been invited. Currently, his activities are also continuing in the People's Republic of China.
